summary: Join our Contract Management in Oil and Gas Training Course to develop key skills for managing contracts efficiently and driving project success in the industry
lede: Contract management for oil and gas helps commercial, procurement, project and legal professionals shape and administer agreements across their lifecycle. It covers interpreting clauses and allocating risk, tracking obligations and performance, and handling variations and claims, so teams can manage contracts from sourcing and award through closeout.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals in the oil and gas industry and related sectors who work with contracts, suppliers, partners, and high-value projects.
audience: Contract managers and contract administrators in oil
Supply chain, procurement, and category managers
Project managers and EPC / maintenance managers
modules: Fundamentals of Oil and Gas Contracts
Contract Strategy and Scoping in Oil and Gas
Dispute Avoidance and Resolution in Oil and Gas
Regulatory, Local Content, and Compliance Requirements
Contract Governance, Close Out, and Lessons Learned
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of the oil and gas industry and some experience with contract management or related fields.
